title: Live six-trial acceptance evidence is not independently verifiable from supplied proof
claim: P19-AC-012 (and the live-provider portions of P19-AC-003/004/005/006) cannot be confirmed or falsified at audit_head because the redacted operator evidence root was not supplied to this audit; only unverified claims in docs/audits/phase19-local-native-acceptance.md(.zh.md) and fixture-tested verifier tooling exist.

evidence.detail: 169-line operator acceptance deliverable with per-criterion claims; its raw proofs (frozen manifest, redacted provider tool loops, six attributable native results) live in an unsupplied private evidence root
No evidence_root parameter was supplied; raw-proof preflight leaves live/operator-class criteria not-assessable

reproduction: python crates/opi-eval/scripts/verify-local-acceptance.py --root <redacted-evidence-root> --out <fresh-out> with the operator's evidence root

title: remediation_native_stage_deadlines asserts a stderr marker no producer emits
claim: The ignored native witness remediation_native_stage_deadlines fails deterministically at audit_head: it requires agent/stderr.log to contain 'stage-witness-start', but commit 0fa995d removed the diagnostic client's stderr emission and left no producer of that marker, so the stage-budget deadline evidence chain cannot be reproduced.

evidence.detail: assert!(stderr.log contains "stage-witness-start") with message 'Agent never started'
writes no stderr by design ('The diagnostic client writes no stderr ... P19-AUD-006')
replaced print('stage-witness-start', file=sys.stderr) with the no-stderr comment without updating the deadline test

reproduction: OPI_EVAL_NATIVE_WITNESS_MATERIAL=<three-family material> cargo test -p opi-eval --test native_driver remediation_native_stage_deadlines -- --ignored --exact (fails at terminal-bench-2.1/positive: 'Agent never started'; reproduced twice on an idle host)

title: Declared AC-008 native verification command executes zero tests
claim: Task 19.7's registered verification command 'cargo test -p opi-eval --test native_driver native_provider_failure_report -- --ignored --exact' selects zero tests: the only test named native_provider_failure_report is not ignored, while the intended exact-client witness is named native_client_provider_failure_report, so the recorded command is vacuous evidence if executed as written.

evidence.detail: non-ignored fixture twin vs ignored native_client_provider_failure_report (different name, pins operator client identities opi 0.8.2 / pi 0.85.1 / source 54b4695)

reproduction: cargo test -p opi-eval --test native_driver native_provider_failure_report -- --ignored --exact (0 tests execute, exit 0)

title: Stale ignore annotation on native_conformance_owned_cleanup_witness
claim: The ignore annotation 'requires frozen three-family material/6 and the real Docker engine' references the superseded material/6 schema; the test actually consumes controlled material/7 via OPI_EVAL_NATIVE_WITNESS_MATERIAL and passes with it.
